component.name: Archcodex
component.summary: Manage Codex projects and conversations in a native workspace

description.p: Archcodex organizes projects and sessions from existing Codex app-servers, displays pushed session status and embeds the Codex terminal interface.

This initial version supports local Unix-socket servers. It requires a compatible Codex CLI installed on the host. Host command access is used to connect and launch terminal clients; it never installs or updates Codex.
